# LeadMagic public API reference

LeadMagic provides B2B email, people, company, jobs, search, advertising, and bulk enrichment APIs.

- Documentation: https://leadmagic.io/docs
- Public schema: https://leadmagic.io/docs/api-reference/openapi.yml
- Documentation index: https://leadmagic.io/docs/llms.txt
- Complete documentation: https://leadmagic.io/docs/llms-full.txt
- Authentication: https://leadmagic.io/docs/v1/authentication
- Credits: https://leadmagic.io/docs/v1/credits
- Search and pagination: https://leadmagic.io/docs/mcp/agent-guide
- Hosted MCP setup: https://leadmagic.io/docs/mcp/setup
- Terminal installation: https://leadmagic.io/docs/cli/installation

REST base URL: https://api.leadmagic.io. Authenticate with X-API-Key from a secret manager or LEADMAGIC_API_KEY environment variable. GET /v1/credits is free.

Hosted MCP uses https://mcp.leadmagic.io/mcp with OAuth. lm-tui installs the lm command and uses lm login.

Email Finder returns validated emails. Validate externally sourced email lists separately. Costs vary by endpoint and plan; confirm paid work before executing it. App-only preview options are not available to REST API keys.

The local YAML and JSON snapshots cover 81 reviewed public paths as of 2026-09-06. Consult current endpoint documentation before relying on a stored snapshot. Never infer public routes from private source code or publish credentials and customer response data.
